edits.current: Only for the pension types R6 marks X (4, 7, 11, 14, 22) or O (12, 20, 21). Jubilación (10) and Convencional (13) carry no pension contribution: campos 30, 35, 40 and 41 stay blank or zero (AT3 v15 ch. 4 §6 table 9, pp. 107-108).
edits.proposed: Only for the pension types R6 marks X (4, 7, 11, 14, 22) or O (12, 20, 21); of the X types, 7 and 22 are not valid for payer type 01 (R02, AT3 v15 pp. 102-103), so for this employer the contributing types are 4, 11 and 14, and optionally 12, 20 and 21. Jubilación (10) and Convencional (13) carry no pension contribution: campos 30, 35, 40 and 41 stay blank or zero (AT3 v15 ch. 4 §6 table 9, pp. 107-108).
edits.why: #24: pension types 7 and 22 flagged as not valid for payer type 01, consistent with Population Rules C14.
edits.evidence: AT3 v15 Tabla 5 'R02 - Regla de validación – Tipo de pensión vs tipo de pagador de pensiones', pp. 102-103: payer type 1 has X for types 2, 3, 4, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 20, 21 and NO X for 7 and 22 (raw/docs/oficiais/CO/2026-10-21-MinSalud-Anexo-Tecnico-3-PILA-pensionados.pdf); same list in Population Rules C14 of the workbook
